title: P1 heartbeat: request
description: The holder extends the lease. Progress only as a stage from the closed list stages of the type and a completion share; there is no streaming of model text (DLV-11). The usage is informational. A repeat with the same arguments gives the same answer (IDM-3). The lease token is not passed in the body: the holder sends it in the Botaru-Lease header (spec/bindings/http/README.md), one way for all operations under a lease (FEN-2).

stage.description: Progress stage from the stages of the task type.

usage.description: Informational usage; only P4 counts money (BUD-3).
